steps.en: Install the core, the headless client, your framework hook and one provider adapter
steps.zh: 装上核心、hook 包与一个 provider 适配包

steps.en: Expose the provider key to the server, never the browser
steps.zh: 把 key 只放服务端，不下发浏览器

steps.en: Write one server route: call chat() with an adapter, return the stream as SSE
steps.zh: 写一条服务端路由：chat() 选定适配器，把流包成 SSE 返回

steps.en: Turns provider replies into one typed event stream and loops through tool calls until done
steps.zh: 把各家模型的回复翻成同一条带类型的流，工具没答完就继续循环

steps.en: Mount the hook in a component, pointed at that route
steps.zh: 在组件里挂上 hook，指向这条路由

steps.en: Appends tokens to messages as chunks arrive, and hands you isLoading and stop
steps.zh: 分片一到就往消息里逐字追加，顺带给 isLoading 和 stop

value.en: A typed streaming chat UI — no hand-parsing SSE, no per-provider glue code, no runtime surprise when a text-only model gets an image
value.zh: 类型安全的流式聊天界面——不用手拆 SSE、不用为每家 provider 写胶水、也不会等纯文本模型收到图片才炸
